scenes.title: The Red Ribbon
scenes.summary: On Tuesday morning Sudha happily recovers her own suitcase and unbroken teacup while the stranger's bag stays under lock and key until Friday.

scenes.title: No Milk in the Fridge
scenes.summary: Twenty minutes before breakfast, Diya's dairy van gets a flat tyre outside town, leaving the kitchen nearly out of milk, eggs, and butter.

scenes.title: Counting the Change
scenes.summary: Kavya sprints back in nine minutes with full bags and exact rupee change, only for Diya to spot that the butter is extra-salty.

scenes.title: Herbs from the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Pratap brings freshly clipped green herbs from the courtyard pots while Kavya and Diya set the four café tables right as guests come downstairs.

scenes.title: Juice on the Tie
scenes.summary: Madam Sudha enjoys black tea without sugar while Mohan pours orange juice with grand flourish and splashes it straight onto his silk tie.

scenes.title: The Friday Caller
scenes.summary: A polite but nervous caller phones the reception desk about the dark-blue suitcase, asks that the white parcel stay unopened, and hangs up.

scenes.title: How Regulars Order
scenes.summary: During the quiet afternoon lull, Diya pours Kavya a cup of coffee while Pratap tightens a wobbly chair screw and pretends not to care about Friday's mystery visitor.

scenes.title: Two Names, One Room
scenes.summary: Checking the evening bookings, Mohan goes pale: without his glasses he booked a second guest into Room 7 on a rainy, sold-out night.
